source.note: block.md Units and contexts: `style:#x` in the label of `a` lies in the line segment before a U+2028 that ends the id `b`, and `#y;` in the label of `c` on the line after the comment line is a line segment of its own for the line rule of style and classDef lines, which it does not match, so its `;` is not ignored; the label of `c` is the placeholder of `#y;`.
